decisions.evidence: The candidate asserts 'Our investment in the Company was predicated on a thesis of predictable... subscriber growth' [L48] and describes the exit as following from the company's loss of predictability [L48], yet the candidate retains the position's thesis structure instead of acknowledging the immediate, exit-on-change requirement defined in the post-2022 Netflix rule [L22, L75: Section 6].
decisions.fix: The candidate should demonstrate strict compliance with the Netflix rule: immediate exit when predictability falls, without attempting to re-underwrite or describe the thesis as 'broken/weakened' while holding [L48, L51].

notes: Candidate C1 identifies the core issue (loss of predictability) but fails to adhere to the explicit rule established by the 2022 Netflix post-mortem: sell immediately upon the change occurring, rather than re-underwriting the investment thesis in the same document.
